PURPOSE: The Executive Opportunity Study (configs/gate_executive_opportunity_v1.json, evidence/gate_executive/opportunity_execute.json) found ExecutiveOpportunity=0.0 exactly because ANSWER_NOW scored 0/750 -- b3_calibration_v1's facts are procedurally synthesized and cannot exist in any pretrained model's weights, so that benchmark structurally cannot produce ANSWER_NOW-vs-MEMORY heterogeneity. EOB-v1 is purpose-built to contain controlled heterogeneity instead of accidentally lacking it.
DO_NOT_TOUCH: CERTIFIED_MEMORY_V1 (configs/certified_memory_v1.json) is not modified by this work. EOB-v1 is new DATA and a new RUNNER only -- retrieval, graph construction, path ranking, the composer, and packet_budget=6 are reused unmodified, gated by assert_certified_memory_v1_unchanged() exactly as the v1 study did.

D0_direct_sufficient.definition: All information needed to answer is contained in the question text itself. No external evidence exists or is needed.
families: arithmetic (a+b, a-b, a*b for small integers stated in the question)
comparison (three named entities with an explicit stated ordering attribute; question asks who ranks highest/lowest)
transform (reverse / uppercase / concatenate a short token stated in the question)
restatement (X is explicitly assigned a value in the question; question asks for X's value)
D0_direct_sufficient.answer_source: pure function of the question string -- verified by an independent reference solver at generation time, not merely asserted
D0_direct_sufficient.evidence_corpus: empty (matches ANSWER_NOW's own empty-packet condition) -- D0 exists to test whether MEMORY invocation is WASTED, not harmful, when there is nothing memory could contribute
D0_direct_sufficient.expected_pattern: Q(ANSWER_NOW) should be high (near ceiling, given a correctly verified reference solver); Q(MEMORY) should be no better (no evidence exists to help) and costs strictly more (retrieval+graph+compose+larger prompt)

D1_memory_required.definition: Answer depends on synthetic facts that exist only in external memory -- reuses the EXISTING, already-audited b3_calibration_v1 generator and corpus rather than regenerating it; that job is already solved and frozen (G2-v4E, S4, HRM qualification, confirmation-2 all validate this generator's correctness).
D1_memory_required.source: sampled from data/hrm/b3_calibration_v1/cal_700 (already frozen, already audited, already CALIBRATION-role -- reuse is legitimate, no new generation)
D1_memory_required.expected_pattern: Q(ANSWER_NOW) at or near 0 (matches the v1 study's finding exactly, for the same construct-validity reason); Q(MEMORY) substantially higher

D2_both_sufficient.definition: A D0-style self-contained question, PLUS a redundant CONFIRMING evidence record stating the same fact in prose. Memory is unnecessary but not harmful if invoked.
D2_both_sufficient.construction: take a D0 task; add exactly one evidence record whose content restates the same fact/answer in a different surface form (not a verbatim copy of the question)
D2_both_sufficient.expected_pattern: Q(ANSWER_NOW) and Q(MEMORY) should both be high and roughly EQUAL -- this is the case the research-lead directive specifically flagged as requiring cost-awareness: quality alone cannot distinguish the actions here, only cost can. The primary utility-v1 study (quality only) is expected to show ExecutiveOpportunity=0 WITHIN this regime specifically, which is the correct, informative outcome for D2, not a benchmark defect.

D3_memory_distractor.definition: A D0-style self-contained question, PLUS a plausible-looking but WRONG or irrelevant evidence record (a similarly-shaped fact about a different quantity). Memory is unnecessary and potentially actively harmful if invoked.
D3_memory_distractor.construction: take a D0 task; add exactly one evidence record with the SAME surface template but a DIFFERENT (wrong, for this question) value -- a near-miss distractor, not random noise, so it has a genuine chance of misleading a model that over-relies on retrieved context over its own direct computation
D3_memory_distractor.expected_pattern: Q(ANSWER_NOW) should match D0's ceiling; Q(MEMORY) may be LOWER than D0's memory condition would be if it existed, if the distractor genuinely misleads generation -- this is the regime most likely to produce cases where Delta_U < 0 (ANSWER_NOW strictly better), which the v1 study found ZERO instances of anywhere.

TASK_COUNTS.rationale: Smaller than the 750-task v1 study by design -- EOB-v1 is a first, exploratory benchmark testing whether controlled heterogeneity CAN be manufactured at all; regime is the treatment variable here, not corpus scale, so multiple scales per regime are not needed the way b3_calibration_v1 needed them for retrieval-pressure calibration.

VERIFICATION_REQUIRED_BEFORE_FREEZE: D0/D2/D3 answers independently re-derived by a reference solver separate from the generator's own internal state (mirrors the existing 'inferability_verified' audit pattern used for the b3/C4 corpora) -- a task is REJECTED, not merely flagged, if the reference solver disagrees with the generator's recorded answer
D2's confirming record does not leak the exact question string verbatim (paraphrased restatement, not a copy)
D3's distractor record is a near-miss (same template, different value) not a random unrelated fact -- verified by checking the distractor's value is explicitly NOT equal to the correct answer
zero content overlap with any consumed split (old C4/C5, b3_calibration_v1 scales other than the cal_700 sample D1 draws from, g2_confirmation_2)

UTILITY_AND_METRICS_CORRECTIONS_FROM_V1.vector_preserved_not_scalar: (Q, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, latency_seconds, compute_proxy) captured for BOTH actions on every task -- utility is NOT collapsed to a scalar U=Q at generation time. A Pareto analysis (which action point-dominates on quality AND cost) is reported BEFORE any scalar U=Q-C(a) is frozen, per research-lead directive: only tasks where quality alone cannot separate the actions (i.e. within D2 specifically) need an explicit cost coefficient; D0/D1/D3 are expected to be resolvable on quality or near-zero-cost grounds alone.
UTILITY_AND_METRICS_CORRECTIONS_FROM_V1.diversity_metric_corrected: Report P(delta_U>0) [MEMORY strictly better], P(delta_U<0) [ANSWER_NOW strictly better], P(delta_U=0) [tie] directly -- NOT an oracle-tie-break action share, which the v1 study showed can manufacture apparent diversity (65% 'A0 chosen') out of pure ties (0% actual A0 wins).

FEATURE_AVAILABILITY_SCHEMA.purpose: Every candidate executive feature must declare WHEN it becomes available relative to the ANSWER_NOW/MEMORY decision, so a future Executive v1 cannot be accidentally given a feature that costs as much to compute as the action it is supposed to gate.
stages: PRE_DECISION -- computable before either action runs (question text alone, cheap query-structure features)
POST_RETRIEVAL -- requires C2 retrieval to have run (identity_status, retrieval_score_margin)
POST_GRAPH -- requires G2 graph construction (graph_reachability, working_set_size, n_complete_paths, structural_competition_ratio, bridge/terminal availability)
POST_GENERATION -- requires HRM to have already run (packet_coherence as observed post-hoc, actual latency/tokens spent)
FEATURE_AVAILABILITY_SCHEMA.hard_rule: The first ANSWER_NOW-vs-MEMORY controller (Executive v0/v1) may use ONLY PRE_DECISION features. POST_RETRIEVAL and POST_GRAPH features remain valid for a LATER controller choosing among a larger action space (RETRIEVE_MORE, GRAPH_REFINE, VERIFY, STOP) where some memory work has already been committed.

SPLIT_DISCIPLINE.this_run: EOB-v1 is a qualification-tier study (like the v1 opportunity study, like HRM qualification) -- used to decide WHETHER an executive is worth building, not to train one.
SPLIT_DISCIPLINE.if_opportunity_confirmed: EOB-v1 itself becomes consumed for that decision, exactly as the research-lead directive specifies. A SEPARATE executive-training split and a later, fresh executive-confirmation split are required before training or confirming any controller -- neither exists yet and neither is built by this work.
